source.author: verg
source.text: Ille malum virus serpentibus addidit atris praedarique lupos iussit pontumque moveri, mellaque decussit foliis ignemque removit et passim rivis currentia vina repressit, ut varias usus meditando extunderet artis paulatim et sulcis frumenti quaereret herbam.
source.text_original: Ille malum virus serpentibus addidit atris / praedarique lupos iussit pontumque moveri, / mellaque decussit foliis ignemque removit / et passim rivis currentia vina repressit, / ut varias usus meditando extunderet artis / paulatim et sulcis frumenti quaereret herbam.
source.text_english: He added deadly venom to black serpents and commanded wolves to prey, and the sea to be stirred, and he knocked honey from the leaves and removed fire, and he checked the wines that flowed everywhere through the streams, so that experience might gradually hammer out various skills by pondering, and he might seek in furrows the grass of grain.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Et iterum: Et passim rivis currentia vina repressit.
reuse.text_original: Et iterum: Et passim rivis currentia vina repressit.
reuse.text_english: And again: And everywhere he checked the wines flowing in streams.
